size.omw.newerContainer: This .omw file was saved by a newer Omniweave (package format {n}). Update the app, then open it again. The file was not changed.
size.menuHint: Lossless optimisation by default; lower photo quality only if you choose it
size.title: Reduce PDF size
size.sub: Lossless by default: text, vectors and images stay exactly as they are; only objects nothing uses and duplicates are removed, and data is recompressed.
size.source.original: Optimise and save the original PDF
size.source.originalHint: Removes earlier revisions appended by edits (incremental saves) and recompresses. Page content stays the same.
size.lossyHint: Re-saves photos only as JPEG. Text and vectors stay the same, but photos will differ from the original.
size.signed: This PDF is signed, so it was kept as an incremental save instead of being rewritten. A full rewrite would invalidate its digital signatures.
size.notSmaller: It couldn't be made smaller; the result is saved without optimisation.
size.noSource: The current page doesn't come from an original PDF, so it can only be exported.
